title: Scaling the Giants: An Interactive Solar System
description: How big is Jupiter really? 🪐 Explore the true scale of our solar system with this interactive 3D model. Drag to zoom and see how Earth compares to the gas giants.

stages.title: The Rocky Neighbors
stages.text: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. Small but resilient. See how tiny our home looks against the vastness of space.
stages.interaction: Observe the orbital speeds of the inner circle.

stages.title: The King of Planets
stages.text: Jupiter is so large that all other planets in the solar system could fit inside it twice. Its massive gravity protects Earth from many asteroid impacts.
stages.interaction: Zoom out to witness the scale of Jupiter and Saturn.

stages.title: The Golden Age of Discovery
stages.text: With eduNest, we bring the wonders of the cosmos to your fingertips. Education should be as vast as the universe.
stages.interaction: Ready to journey further? Join eduNest.

parent_guidance: Ask your child: if the Sun were a basketball, how big do you think Earth would be? (Answer: a small grape!)
